title: Engines / quota / overrides (tmux, fake forge): tier order and effort match the run record, brief and launch argv; a role override beats the tier order; a reviewer avoids every actual builder engine, and mixed builder engines or a steer with no diverse engine refuse with no window; a quota steer re-orders the reviewer; Muse is never launched on a private or unverified repo, and a steer past it starts one fresh session

steps.name: up
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; R={state_dir}/../repo; mk() { n=$1; shift; git -C $R checkout -q -B b$n main && for e in "$@"; do echo "$e" >> $R/f$n.txt && git -C $R add f$n.txt && git -C $R -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x commit -qm "feat: $n" -m "Engine: $e" || return 1; done && git -C $R push -q -f origin HEAD:refs/pull/$n/head HEAD:refs/heads/builder/$n-x && git -C $R checkout -q main; }; eng() { python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(r['engine'], r['model'], r['effort'])" $S/runs/$1.json; }; brief() { sed -n "s/^- Engine: //p" $S/runs/$1.brief.md; }; argv() { grep " id=$1 argv=" {state_dir}/stub.log | tail -1 | sed "s/.* argv=//"; }; same() { test "$(eng $1)" = "$2" && test "$(brief $1)" = "$2" || { echo "$1: record $(eng $1), brief $(brief $1), want $2"; exit 1; }; }; gone() { ! test -e $S/runs/$1.json && ! ls $S/claims | grep -q "^reviewer-pr$2-" && ! tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_name}" | grep -qx $1; }; kr() { CREW_POOL=reviewer $C kill $1 $P >/dev/null; }; org() { printf "[engines.roles.%s]\norder = [%s]\n" "$1" "$2" > {state_dir}/org-$3.toml; }; mkdir -p $G && echo [] > $G/pr-list.json && echo [] > $G/issue-list.json && echo '{"defaultBranchRef":{"name":"main"}}' > $G/repo-view.json && $C up $P >/dev/null
